name: ELATERIUM OFFICINARUM
key_symptoms: Nausea and vomiting, with great weakness. Griping pains in bowels.
Sharp pains in fingers and thumbs, knees, toes, and instep. Gouty pain in great toes. Pain extends down extremities; pain in hip-joints with diarrhœa. Arthritic nodules.

gi_symptoms: Nausea and vomiting, with great weakness. Griping pains in bowels.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Sharp pains in fingers and thumbs, knees, toes, and instep. Gouty pain in great toes. Pain extends down extremities; pain in hip-joints with diarrhœa. Arthritic nodules.
skin_symptoms: Smarts, stings, and burns. Dropsical. Urticaria from suppressed intermittent. Skin, orange color.
fever_symptoms: Chill comes on with much yawning and stretching, lasting all through chill. Pain in extremities, darting into fingers and toes. Chills and fever, with spurting diarrhœa.
